nodes.description: ACAD9 binds NDUFAF1 and ECSIT within the mitochondrial complex I assembly complex. ECSIT binding opens the ACAD9 FAD-binding loop, releases FAD, and switches ACAD9 from its acyl-CoA dehydrogenase state into a complex I assembly-factor state. Disease-causing ACAD9 variants impair this assembly function.

nodes.description: Riboflavin is a commonly attempted empiric treatment. Complex I activity improved in 9/15 patient fibroblast lines, whereas 6/15 did not respond. Physicians reported clinical benefit in 20/31 retrospectively described patients and no effect in 11/31; a 2026 systematic review classified 22/29 reported patients as responsive. These overlapping, nonrandomized reports support a possible benefit but do not establish a causal survival effect, optimal regimen, or reliable response predictor.
